description: Held-out follow-up attempts on the repeat_text check (target misconception MC-BASE-SMALLEST). Expected outcome is what a careful instructor would conclude from the code and the reasoning together. Hand-written after verify-v1 was fixed.

cases.explanation: It ends when n hits zero, giving back an empty string, since zero copies of anything is nothing.
The base case is n == 0, which returns the empty string.
It finishes when it runs out of times to repeat, then it is done.

cases.code:
def repeat_text(s, n):
    return '' if n == 0 else s + repeat_text(s, n - 1)
cases.explanation: The base case n == 0 returns '' because repeating zero times gives the empty string; each call reduces n so it always gets there.
It stops when n is 0 and returns s.
